parent_objective: freeze a bounded non-ranking measured-validation design over the M2410 source-linked reset panel
blocked_by: M2410 is reset-only and does not measure driver outcomes
unmatched source-key diagnostics must be preserved in measured-validation interpretation
candidate family membership is overlapping and cannot be ranked as mutually exclusive
supersedes: direct measured validation without frozen denominator

public_gates: M2412 must freeze a measured-validation denominator before any rollout
M2412 must use M2410 unique reset targets as concrete env-config units
M2412 must preserve family-membership overlap instead of ranking families
M2412 must preserve the 95 unmatched source-key diagnostic caveat
M2412 must require no active config overwrite, no actor input change, and no hidden/oracle actor features
M2412 must not run measured rollout, reset environments, execute repair, train, rank, select winner, or make verdict claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not inject hidden or oracle actor features
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim scenario redesign executed
do not claim training repair success

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: freezes a bounded measured-validation protocol for the M2410 reset panel before execution
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no measured rollout, repair execution, training, ranking, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, self-ID, scenario-redesign-executed, training-repair, or current-sim verdict claim
stop_condition: stop if measured validation cannot preserve overlapping family membership
stop if the denominator uses source-linked scenario refs as independent episodes instead of unique reset targets
stop if the design requires ranking families or selecting a winner
stop if the design ignores unmatched source-key diagnostics
stop if the design requires active config overwrite or actor input changes
fallback_plan: if denominator is ambiguous, audit reset target membership before measured execution
if family overlap is too dense for interpretation, pivot to diagnostic measured slices rather than ranking
if design is accepted, route to bounded measured-validation implementation
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: synthesize after at most 10 milestones in this branch or immediately if measured evidence cannot be admitted

admission_evidence: M2410 has 350 unique reset targets and 350 reset successes
allowed_updates: M2412 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the design
next_stage_criteria: pass/fail and claim boundaries are defined

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2412 designs measured validation but does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2412; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU verdict is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If measured validation is admitted, outcome interpretation must remain engineering/task-quality evidence unless a later history intervention branch is run.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, effective-candidate ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, scenario-redesign-executed result, training-repair result, current-sim verdict, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: freezes a measured-validation protocol after reset evidence instead of running an unfrozen panel
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can admit measured-validation implementation but cannot establish measured performance or current-sim verdict
must_synthesize_if: another design-only milestone is proposed before measured execution
family overlap becomes a ranking shortcut
five milestones pass without reset or measured evidence

hypothesis: A bounded 350-reset-target x selected-checkpoint measured-validation protocol can measure the source-linked family panel without ranking overlapping families or changing actor inputs.
success_criteria: the selected checkpoint set is declared
family membership overlap handling is declared
the 95 unmatched source-key caveat is preserved
a bounded implementation route is selected or the branch is stopped
no reset rerun rollout repair training ranking or verdict claim is made
failure_criteria: M2412 runs reset or measured validation
M2412 ranks candidate families or selects a winner
M2412 uses hidden or oracle actor inputs
M2412 makes measured performance, current-sim, paper, FW-vs-GRU, or self-ID claims
decision_rule: M2412 passes if it freezes a bounded non-ranking measured-validation protocol over the M2410 reset panel and selects an implementation route or stops without reset rerun, rollout, repair, training, ranking, or verdict claims.
